author: hasl
body:
Hello all o/,

With the conclusion of another very successful event, the event team are striving to improve for what the future holds. Hence why I created another survey to aid the feedback process. 

Please complete with honesty: https://blizzem.typeform.com/to/NE4CqH

The more personal questions aren't required, so you can submit your feedback completely anonymously if you wish.

Thanks in advance,
-The Event Team

N.B: This is unofficial, but I have a seal of approval from an official.
